subject: physics
title: Applications of Electromagnetic Induction MCQ Problems

problems.question: Which device uses electromagnetic induction to convert mechanical energy into electrical energy?
problems.hint: Think about Faraday’s law and how induction creates voltage.
problems.detailed:
A generator uses electromagnetic induction to produce an induced electromotive force (EMF) when coils rotate in a magnetic field. This converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
Generators are a primary example of this application.
problems.author: Keyner Avendano

problems.question: A transformer is used to change the value of an alternating voltage. What type of current must be supplied for a transformer to work?
problems.hint: Transformers rely on changing magnetic flux.
problems.detailed: Transformers only work with alternating current (AC) because AC produces a changing magnetic flux, which induces a voltage in the secondary coil according to Faraday’s law. Direct current (DC) does not produce a changing flux and therefore cannot be used in transformers.
problems.author: Keyner Avendano
